cases.name: Donna Kathleen Ceremony
cases.about: Ceremony’s family shared that she was incredibly resilient, taking her own challenges and turning them into an opportunity to help others. The family added that she had an infectious laugh, and loved animals, all things purple and the San Francisco 49ers.
cases.narrative: Witcher had been staying at the Market Street Manor Motel for the prior two weeks and was involved in the resident treatment programs. The motel served as a transitional housing location. At a morning meeting, Witcher suddenly attacked two residents and two staff members with a large butcher-style knife without apparent provocation.
